name: Sheet
import: import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetDescription, SheetBody, SheetFooter, SheetClose } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
description: A modal edge panel for mobile navigation, selectors, and compact side workflows.

Sheet.description: Root state holder built on Base UI Dialog.

onOpenChange.description: Called when trigger, close, escape, or outside press changes open state.

modal.description: Keep modal for most sheets so focus stays inside the panel.

SheetTrigger.description: Control that opens the sheet. Compose with kubkit Button through render.

render.description: Use render={<Button />} so triggers use kubkit Button styling.

SheetContent.description: Portal-backed panel with backdrop, viewport, and sliding popup.

children.description: Header, body, footer, or a custom panel layout.

showCloseButton.description: Shows an icon close button in the top-right corner.

initialFocus.description: Base UI focus target when opened.

finalFocus.description: Base UI focus target when closed.

className.description: Layout escape hatch only; do not restyle surface, shadow, or placement language.

SheetHeader.description: Fixed header area for title, description, or compact toolbar.

children.description: Usually SheetTitle, optional SheetDescription, and small header actions.
Short title naming the navigation area or workflow.
Navigation, selectors, forms, or task content.
Primary and secondary actions composed from kubkit Button.
Visible close/cancel label when used in footer or custom header.

render.description: Use render={<Button variant="secondary" />} for styled close actions.

forbidden: Do not use Sheet for plain text hints; use Tooltip.
Do not use Sheet for short anchored controls; use Popover.
Do not use Sheet for required decisions; use AlertDialog from the Dialog module.
Do not add visible custom borders to the sheet surface.
Do not place a long workflow in a bottom sheet; use a right or left sheet.

responsive.note: Use bottom sheets for short mobile selectors, side sheets for navigation or longer workflows. Header and footer actions must keep 44px touch targets.

example:
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger render={<Button />}>Open panel</SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Panel title</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>Short helper text.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>
    <SheetBody>{/* scrollable content */}</SheetBody>
    <SheetFooter>
      <SheetClose render={<Button variant="secondary" />}>Cancel</SheetClose>
      <Button>Save</Button>
    </SheetFooter>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
